description: 10 scenarios testing the orchestrator's ability to detect single vs. multiple intents and select the correct routing pattern (parallel, sequential, or conditional).

scenarios.title: Cancel PO and check inventory simultaneously
scenarios.prompt: Cancel my procurement PO and check current inventory levels for those items.

expected_routing.notes: Both actions are independent and should be dispatched simultaneously. PO number must be clarified before routing.

failure_modes: Routes only to ProcurementAgent, drops inventory check
Executes sequentially instead of in parallel
Asks for PO number but then forgets to use it for inventory lookup
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Stockout risk if inventory check is skipped; delayed procurement cycle if sequential instead of parallel.

scenarios.title: Approve expense then book travel in sequence
scenarios.prompt: First approve my expense report, then book the travel once it's approved.

expected_routing.notes: Travel booking depends on expense approval. The word 'first...then' signals sequential dependency.

failure_modes: Books travel before expense is approved
Dispatches agents in parallel ignoring the sequential dependency
Approves expense but does not continue to travel booking
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Policy violation if travel is booked before approval; financial exposure from unapproved spend.

scenarios.title: Cancel subscription and update billing email
scenarios.prompt: Cancel my subscription and also update my billing email address.

expected_routing.notes: Both actions are independent. No dependency between cancellation and email update.

failure_modes: Only cancels subscription, ignores email update
Updates email first, then cancels — unnecessary sequential dependency
Cancels subscription without confirming new email, leaving billing records stale
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Customer receives billing correspondence at old address; failed dunning notifications post-cancellation.

scenarios.title: Book meeting and check calendar availability
scenarios.prompt: Can you book me a meeting for tomorrow and also tell me if I'm free in the afternoon?

expected_routing.notes: Availability check should inform booking, but both queries can be issued in parallel against the calendar system.

failure_modes: Books meeting without first verifying the user is free
Checks availability only, does not proceed to booking
Treats as single intent: only checks availability
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Double-booking risk; degraded executive productivity from scheduling conflicts.

scenarios.title: Check order status then evaluate return eligibility
scenarios.prompt: My order is late and I want to know whether I can still return it.

expected_routing.notes: Must retrieve order details (delivery date, item condition) before evaluating return window eligibility.

failure_modes: Checks return policy in isolation without fetching order details
Answers only about the delay, ignores return eligibility
Routes to ReturnPolicyAgent with insufficient order context
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Customer dissatisfaction; incorrect return decision (approve expired or deny eligible return).

scenarios.title: Reset password and notify user via work email
scenarios.prompt: Reset my password and also send the new login details to my work email.

expected_routing.notes: Password must be reset first to obtain new credentials before notification can be sent.

failure_modes: Sends notification before reset completes
Resets password but does not trigger notification
Dispatches both agents in parallel — notification has no credentials to send yet
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Security risk if credentials sent before reset; user locked out if notification never sent.

scenarios.title: Check balance and conditionally transfer funds
scenarios.prompt: Check my account balance and transfer 200 euros if the funds are available.

expected_routing.notes: Balance check gates the transfer. Transfer only proceeds if balance >= 200 EUR. Must not transfer without verification.

failure_modes: Transfers without checking balance first
Checks balance but ignores the transfer intent
Routes both in parallel — transfer agent acts without balance data
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Overdraft, failed transaction, or regulatory compliance violation.

scenarios.title: Retrieve vacation policy and check leave availability
scenarios.prompt: Tell me the policy for vacation days and whether I can take next Friday off.

expected_routing.notes: Policy lookup and leave balance check are independent; both can run concurrently.

failure_modes: Returns policy only, does not check Friday availability
Checks leave balance without fetching the applicable policy
Conflates the two questions into a single HR query
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Employee takes unauthorized leave; HR compliance breach from unapplied regional policy.

scenarios.title: Cancel hotel and verify airline ticket validity
scenarios.prompt: Cancel my hotel booking and make sure the airline ticket is still valid.

expected_routing.notes: Hotel cancellation and ticket verification are fully independent actions.

expected_clarification: Flight booking reference or ticket number
failure_modes: Cancels hotel only, ignores ticket check
Checks ticket first sequentially before cancelling hotel
Treats as single travel intent, routes to a single travel agent
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Traveler left with cancelled accommodation but unknown flight status; stranded at destination risk.

scenarios.title: Approve leave and source shift coverage simultaneously
scenarios.prompt: Approve my leave request and find coverage for my shift while I'm out.

expected_routing.notes: Both actions can begin in parallel. Coverage search does not need to wait for leave approval — both should be initiated simultaneously to minimize turnaround.

expected_clarification: Shift details (date, time, role, required skills)
failure_modes: Approves leave without initiating coverage search
Waits for approval before searching coverage — unnecessary bottleneck
Searches coverage without confirming leave dates
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Operational disruption from uncovered shifts; delayed leave approval blocking employee planning.
